absent: Underlying filter execution helpers for packet, socket, address, operations, device, sysctl and option paths beyond gating and argument forwarding
Enabled build definitions of global and per socket enablement predicates and full socket resolution helpers
Socket lock semantics, ordering against other locks, and sleep or interrupt constraints
Bind exemption flag values and device access encodings and sysctl buffer handling contracts
Map operation error codes, locking, concurrency and batch attribute layouts
BTF record construction, validation and lifetime and module reference rules
Attach, detach, link and query semantics when the feature is enabled

findings.text: Two packet path helpers expose cgroup filtering for inbound and outbound traffic. Each yields an integer verdict that stays neutral when the corresponding hook is not active. The inbound form proceeds only when a global hook flag and a per socket flag both indicate activity and the socket reference is present and represents a full socket. The outbound form additionally resolves the socket to its full form and requires agreement between the socket derived from the socket argument and the socket derived from the packet before checking the per socket flag.

A generic socket program runner plus thin wrappers cover creation, release and post bind events for IPv4 and IPv6. The generic runner checks global enablement for the supplied attach type and otherwise returns neutral. Each wrapper fixes the attach type to one lifecycle event and forwards the socket argument.

Socket address filtering is exposed through an unlocked helper and a locking helper that both take a socket, an address blob with length, an attach type and optional context. A bind specific locking helper adds an output flags word and propagates a no capability privilege exemption from the filter result to caller supplied bind flags. A pre connect predicate reports true only when either IPv4 or IPv6 connect filtering is globally active and the socket protocol provides a pre connect callback.

Family specific wrappers bind the generic address helpers to concrete attach types for stream connect, datagram and unix send and receive. Non locking connect wrappers exist for IPv4 and IPv6, while locking forms exist for IPv4, IPv6 and unix connect and for IPv4, IPv6 and unix send and receive message paths, with send variants forwarding a transient context pointer.

Locking address helpers serialize against concurrent socket state changes by holding the socket lock only around the underlying filter invocation. The lock is acquired after confirming global enablement and released before interpreting results or returning. The bind variant interprets its flag word after release, so caller flag mutation happens without the lock held.

Additional hooks cover socket operations callbacks, device permission checks, sysctl access, and socket option get and set. Socket operations has a direct socket form and a sock ops container form that validates the embedded socket. Device and sysctl forms gate on their global enable flags. Set option gates on both global and per socket flags. Get option preserves the incoming return value by default, consults an optional protocol bypass callback to decide whether filtering can be skipped, and has a kernel internal variant that checks only global enablement.

When the cgroup BPF feature is compiled out, enablement always reports inactive and every packet, socket lifecycle, address, connect, send, receive, operations, device, sysctl and set option helper evaluates to a neutral zero without touching arguments. Both get option helpers instead evaluate to the caller supplied return value they received, preserving prior outcome.

Lifecycle management entry points in the sampled configuration are inert. Initialization performs no action. Program attach, detach, link attach and query each report invalid argument failure without inspecting state beyond their parameters. Common function prototype lookup yields no handler, cgroup storage assignment and percpu copy and update report success without effect, allocation yields absence, and release performs no action.

Iteration support defines a five input integer callback returning an integer, an initializer returning an integer status and taking opaque private data, a finalizer taking the same opaque data with no result, and a generic function pointer returning an unsigned integer from opaque input. The sequence info record aggregates a sequence operations reference, the initializer and finalizer pointers, and a size describing the private area.

The map operations table centralizes polymorphic behavior for BPF maps. It groups syscall oriented management such as allocation validation, allocation, release, free, key iteration, reference release and batched lookup update and delete with lookup and delete combined; dual context element access such as lookup, update, delete, queue push pop peek, percpu lookup and hash; file descriptor translation with lifetime guarantees and code generation and display helpers; type validation and poke tracking and execution; direct value address translation; memory mapping fault poll and unmapped area handling; local storage charging and owner pointer access; plus redirect, inner map compatibility comparison, iteration callback setup and execution, memory accounting, a type identifier pointer and an iterator description pointer.

ABI facts state maximum BTF fields eleven. Field kinds are powers of two with decimal values spin lock one, timer two, unreferenced kernel pointer four, referenced kernel pointer eight, percpu kernel pointer sixteen, list head thirty two, list node sixty four, red black root one hundred twenty eight, red black node two hundred fifty six, reference count five hundred twelve, workqueue one thousand twenty four, uptr two thousand forty eight, resilient spin lock four thousand ninety six, task work eight thousand one hundred ninety two. Combined masks are any kernel pointer twenty eight, any graph node three hundred twenty, any graph root one hundred sixty. Cgroup storage kinds are shared zero and percpu one with maximum sentinel two. The storage iteration helper walks upward from zero while below maximum when enabled and performs no iteration when disabled.

Destructor callbacks take opaque object data with no result. Kernel pointer field metadata carries a type system reference, an owning module reference, an optional destructor for kernel resident types and a type identifier. Graph root metadata carries a type system reference, a value type identifier, a node offset and a value record reference. Each field descriptor carries byte offset and size plus a kind tag and a union holding either kernel pointer or graph root metadata. Each record carries a field count, a presence mask, cached offsets for spin lock, resilient spin lock, timer, workqueue, reference count and task work, followed by a flexible array of field descriptors.
Two intrusive container helpers pair a linkage node with an owner back pointer. One wraps a red black tree node, the other wraps a list head. Both require eight byte alignment.

Egress and socket operations paths revalidate socket identity to avoid acting on unexpected objects. Egress resolves the supplied socket to full form and requires it to match the full socket associated with the packet. The container form of socket operations resolves the embedded socket and requires full socket status. Ingress requires a non null full socket. These checks prevent filter execution against half initialized, mismatched or already released socket views.
The BPF core header defines a once only inclusion guard that evaluates to one, ensuring repeated inclusion has no additional effect.
